title: Thirsty Flower
central_conflict: a rare flower began drooping as its watering can ran dry
decisive_choice: a string could wick water slowly from the bucket into the dry soil
resolution: set up the simple wick and watched the flower recover by morning
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered a rare flower began drooping as its watering can ran dry before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they carried a bucket uphill, but most water spilled over the rocky path; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a string could wick water slowly from the bucket into the dry soil; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they set up the simple wick and watched the flower recover by morning, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: Broken Box Lid

resolution: repaired the hinge and carried the dry donations to the community hall

title: Snow-Covered Lantern
central_conflict: the safety lantern disappeared beneath a fresh blanket of snow
decisive_choice: a warm patch beneath a nearby stone showed where its flame had melted snow
resolution: dug out the lantern safely and marked the route with bright ribbons
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the safety lantern disappeared beneath a fresh blanket of snow before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they swept the path, but the next gust hid every familiar landmark; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a warm patch beneath a nearby stone showed where its flame had melted snow; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they dug out the lantern safely and marked the route with bright ribbons, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
